The main takeaway from our work is that
the HOM dampers are designed to be compatible with the ARES cavity system and that the RF power loss of the HOM damper is minimized to be less than 1% of the RF power loss in the cavity.
the cavity structure is designed for 1.5 GHz RF operation and that the cavity has been tested with a pulsed RF power of 2.4 MW, which is twice as large as that of the KEKB MR.
the RF cavity can be designed for the damping ring of SuperKEKB with a low HOM power dissipation and a high reliability.
